metadata.description: llmlint: ignore[browser_journeys_run_against_the_built_app] This workspace declares each app's browser journey on the app itself rather than in a second Nx project, and the journey still drives the built artifact rather than a development server: this target dependsOn shell:prerender, so Playwright only ever opens the composed production bundle Pages publishes. Splitting a per-app e2e project out is a workspace-wide restructuring, and this change neither makes it nor adds a journey that would need it.

llmlint: ignore[changed_behavior_has_e2e] This target only declares the shared @nx/rspack:dev-server executor for skills; it builds no byte a visitor is served, because just serve-dev composes the published artifact for every app it is not developing. The one code path the declaration reaches is scripts/serve/serve-dev.mjs, and serve-dev.spec.ts drives that path in a real browser through both shapes an app can take under it — the composing host (shell) and a remote pane (awards), whose edit it also follows into the composed host — while apps/skills/e2e/skills.spec.ts and apps/skills/e2e/ownership.spec.ts keep skills's published bytes covered standalone and host-composed.
